phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

key_findings.so_confirm: action_confirm sets state=sale; sale_stock._action_confirm calls _action_launch_stock_rule which creates stock.picking via stock.rule.run; NO account.move created at confirm.
key_findings.delivery_validate: button_validate -> _action_done (picking) -> stock_account._action_done: freeze values, super(), create_account_move with company stock journal, immediately post. Entry: DR customer-location valuation_account_id (COGS) / CR product categ stock_valuation_account_id.
key_findings.cogs_account: COGS account is the destination (customer) location's valuation_account_id. Stock valuation account is categ_id.property_stock_valuation_account_id. Same accounts for standard-cost and AVCO; only monetary value differs.
key_findings.invoice_create: _create_invoices -> _prepare_invoice (move_type=out_invoice, default sale journal) -> _create_account_invoices (sudo). Line revenue account from product income account. AR line from partner.property_account_receivable_id.
key_findings.payment_register: action_create_payments -> _create_payments -> _init_payments + _post_payments + _reconcile_payments. Payment entry: DR outstanding_account_id (payment method line account) / CR destination_account_id (receivable).
key_findings.reconcile: _reconcile_payments calls reconcile() on (payment_lines + invoice_lines) for matching account. Creates account.partial.reconcile records. If fully matched: creates account.full.reconcile. invoice.line_ids(receivable).reconciled=True, amount_residual=0.
key_findings.state_machine: delivery_status='full' when all pickings done/cancel. invoice_status='invoiced' when all SO lines invoiced. No single O2C completion method; three independent computed fields.
